notes.title: Recenter Aircraft and Vertical Loops
notes.notes:
Players can now recenter their aircraft by selecting the recenter aircraft button in the options for each aircraft, or simply by pressing the right hand primary button.

Vertical Loops are now possible with the relaxing of the stalling function, making flight easier and more fun to enjoy!!!
